e6362b7b35fb46f7.description: About the Role National Initiative Human Resource Company is seeking an experienced Cyber Security Manager to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves leading and overseeing the company's cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk management, operations, and compliance. The manager will focus on protecting IT and OT environments, ensuring adherence to Saudi regulatory requirements and international standards, and enhancing the organization's overall cybersecurity resilience. Key Responsibilities Lead and implement the cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, and initiatives across Saudi operations. Develop and maintain cybersecurity policies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks. Ensure compliance with Saudi cybersecurity regulations, including NCA ECC, CCC, OTCC, and PDPL. Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments and oversee risk mitigation plans. Manage internal and external cybersecurity audits and compliance assessments. Oversee Security Operations Center (SOC) activities, incident response, and threat monitoring. Manage third-party cybersecurity risks and supplier security assessments. Ensure security requirements are integrated into IT, OT, cloud, infrastructure, and manufacturing projects. Oversee cybersecurity protection for manufacturing environments, including IT/OT segmentation. Lead cybersecurity awareness initiatives and coordinate incident response and recovery exercises. Report cybersecurity risks, incidents, and performance to senior management. Lead and develop the cybersecurity team, defining responsibilities and priorities. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of experience in cybersecurity management or a related field. The role requires a strong background in leading cybersecurity strategies and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves working within a dynamic environment focused on protecting critical IT and OT infrastructures.

e67190c06518a91d.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director – Project Management to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. Reporting to the Executive Director of Delivery, the role ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, and adhere to required quality, safety, and sustainability standards, aligning with overall business objectives. Develop and manage project schedules, budgets, resource plans, risks, and key deliverables. Coordinate with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders to ensure effective communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Monitor project performance, identify risks and issues, and implement corrective actions to maintain delivery objectives. Prepare and present project progress and performance reports to senior management. Ensure compliance with required safety regulations, quality standards, and sustainability practices. Lead, mentor, and develop project managers and team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing project environment. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess extensive project management experience within large-scale development and construction environments. A proven track record of delivering complex projects, particularly within the entertainment, leisure, or hospitality sectors, is required. Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to manage project schedules, budgets, resources, risks, and performance effectively. e607ed0134265650.description: About the Role DAR ENGINEERING is seeking an OHTL Designer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. Assist the project team with project deliverables. Ensure the timely production and quality of assigned work. Support the project engineer in Bill of Quantity (BOQ) take-offs. e63d51279271cb62.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الهفوف. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية بأنواعها المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية، وفهم مكوناتها بدقة. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ جميع أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية المختلفة. معرفة قوية بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في الأعمال الكهربائية. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة المجال العربي في مدينة الهفوف بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالمعايير المهنية العالية والعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

e63d75cacbf2f075.company_name: Mohammad Al Habib Real Estate Co.
e63d75cacbf2f075.description: About the Role alfanar is seeking a Procurement Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on executing core procurement activities, including sourcing, contracting, and supplier development, to ensure the acquisition of materials, services, assets, MRO, and general purchases with the correct specifications, price, quality, and delivery time from the right sources. Key Responsibilities Develop suppliers to achieve objectives related to cost savings, delivery performance, and material quality. Conduct regular supplier performance evaluations to establish development plans and sourcing activities. Visit suppliers for prequalification, evaluation, and development, strengthening business partnerships in coordination with commodity heads and business unit (BU) quality teams. Execute sourcing and contracting plans based on the AED sourcing strategy. Maximize contracted items with approved suppliers to secure prices, delivery, payment terms, and quality, while optimizing purchasing cycle time. Ensure commercial, legal, and contractual compliance in all procurement transactions. Understand detailed requirements for each purchase request, including specifications, quantity, UOM, and delivery date, in alignment with requesters or BU technical teams. Manage the execution of purchase requests by processing RFx (RFQ, RFI) from identified approved/qualified supplier lists. Negotiate for optimal purchase conditions, considering specifications, delivery time, and cost elements (price, delivery date, Incoterm/payment term). Initiate alternative material specifications based on market availability, involving relevant BU technical teams. Compare quotations using approved forms, focusing on commercial (landed cost) and delivery terms. Identify selected suppliers with input from BU technical teams/requesters and issue Purchase Orders (POs) to the winning supplier. Ensure POs include all required attached documents (quotations, communications). Follow the Alfanar PO approval matrix to obtain final approved orders. Send approved POs to suppliers and follow up for acknowledgment. Monitor PO delivery schedules with suppliers and relevant departments (Inbound Logistics) until materials arrive and the order is closed. Contribute to procurement activities (sourcing, development, evaluation, contracting) with coordination from commodity heads. Maintain and update vendor master information. Manage non-conformity processes for rejected materials and lead corrective/preventive actions with other departments (Quality, Store, Finance). General Accountabilities Acquire updated soft and technical skills relevant to the role. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve operational problems and escalate complex issues as needed. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures. Qualifications and Experience 4-6 years of relevant experience in procurement or a related field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

e64eb9b9d5c578d6.company_name: مجمع سلمان مرزوق عوض الحربي الطبي
e64eb9b9d5c578d6.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking a Dermatology Consultant to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves diagnosing and treating dermatological conditions, examining patients, and providing comprehensive medical care within the Dermatology department. Key Responsibilities Assess patients and accurately document findings. Design and execute individualized patient care plans. Educate patients on their health conditions, required investigations, treatment options, and medication use. Provide patient education on health promotion and disease prevention. Order and review results of patient investigations. Prescribe appropriate medications for patients. Fulfill all obligations related to patient records. Integrate population factors such as heritage, environment, and disease prevalence into patient care. Compliance and Professional Development Adhere to all Nahdi Care Clinics (NCC) Policies and Procedures (P&P), Bylaws, Strategic Plan, Rules & Regulation. Comply with the mission, vision, goals, and practice guidelines of NCC. Actively participate in assigned NCC Committees and Task Forces. Adhere to CBAHI standards of care and participate in continuous quality improvement activities. Establish and maintain effective working relationships with other departments, agencies, vendors, patients, and their families. Participate in the continuous professional development of junior staff. Develop, participate, and support an active Continuing Medical Education program as assigned. Specialty Tasks Perform specific privileges based on training, experience, skills, and in accordance with Saudi health council guidelines. Undertake additional tasks as determined by specialty and clinical privileges. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in Dermatology. The role requires an evidence-based approach to patient care and a commitment to clinical excellence. Work Environment This position operates in an indoor clinical setting (100%). The work schedule is 6 working days per week with 1 day off, comprising 8 net working hours daily according to a shift schedule approved by the head of the department.

e66167043243827e.company_name: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
e66167043243827e.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking a Research User Computing Linux Specialist to join its team in Thuwal, Makkah. This full-time role involves designing, operating, and continuously improving KAUST's Linux-based research end-user computing platforms. The specialist will ensure secure, reliable, and high-performance access to scientific desktop environments for faculty, researchers, and students. Key Responsibilities Administer, maintain, and improve Ubuntu and Rocky Linux end-user platforms to provide stable and secure scientific workstation services. Develop, standardize, and maintain Linux workstation builds and images for physical and virtual scientific desktops. Manage and support remote scientific workstation platforms, including NICE DCV and Kasm Workspaces. Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, monitoring, and compliance activities using scripting, configuration management, Infrastructure as Code, and GitOps-aligned practices. Troubleshoot and resolve complex Linux endpoint, workstation, remote desktop, GPU, driver, performance, identity, storage, and network-related issues. Integrate Linux desktops and workstations with enterprise IAM, storage, network, monitoring, security, and endpoint management services. Partner with faculty, researchers, students, research labs, HPC, storage, security, and advanced computing teams to translate requirements into sustainable workstation solutions. Support installation, validation, and maintenance of scientific and research software on Linux workstation environments. Implement and maintain security and compliance controls for Linux workstation environments, including patching, hardening, audit logging, and endpoint security. Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, user guidance, dashboards, and service metrics. Evaluate new Linux desktops, remote access, virtualization, automation, and scientific workstation technologies, providing recommendations for improvement. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the realm of the employee's knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of the position. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in Linux-based end-user computing environments. The position requires a strong understanding of Linux operating systems, specifically Ubuntu and Rocky Linux, and experience with scientific workstation platforms. Technical Skills Proficiency in administering and maintaining Ubuntu and Rocky Linux environments. Experience with remote scientific workstation platforms such as NICE DCV and Kasm Workspaces. Skills in automation using scripting, configuration management, Infrastructure as Code, and GitOps. Ability to troubleshoot complex issues related to Linux endpoints, GPUs, drivers, performance, identity, storage, and networking. Familiarity with enterprise IAM, storage, network, monitoring, security, and endpoint management services. Knowledge of security and compliance controls for Linux workstation environments. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Thuwal, Makkah, at KAUST. The role involves collaboration with various academic and research teams, requiring strong communication and partnership skills to support scientific workflows effectively.

e66289b08f12faea.description: About the Role Saudi German Health is seeking an experienced Pharmacy Manager to join their team in Abha, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a qualified professional with strong leadership skills and a background in hospital pharmacy operations. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a commitment to patient safety and operational excellence within pharmaceutical services. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily pharmacy operations for both Inpatient (IP) and Outpatient (OP) services. Manage pharmacy budgets, focusing on cost optimization, inventory control, and resource allocation. e6c8c71ce1f8a003.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة يوتيليتي القابضة عن فني كهربائي أنظمة حماية كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة المخططات التنفيذية لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية، وتحديد المواد والأجهزة اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة وتشخيص الأعطال. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات التنفيذية لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس. تحديد كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة ومطابقة مواصفاتها وتأمينها لتنفيذ العمل. متابعة الإجراءات التنفيذية لأعمال التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس. تشخيص أعطال أنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس، وتحديد أسبابها، ومراقبة إجراءات الصيانة. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات التنفيذية لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بأجهزة العد والقياس الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الفنية. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل فني كهربائي أنظمة حماية كهربائية بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب الدور التفاعل مع فرق العمل المختلفة لضمان تنفيذ المهام بكفاءة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة يوتيليتي القابضة.

e6485f2cd11945ab.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة العصري الحديثة التجارية عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات شاملة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة ولباقة في التعامل. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور.

e6c84b4d2d3bf2a3.job_title: Business Unit Manager Machining & Mechanical Services
e6c84b4d2d3bf2a3.description: About Naqa Iron Company Naqa Iron Company for Engineering Products is an industrial workshop located in Yanbu Industrial City, Saudi Arabia. The company specializes in machining, repairing, and remaking parts for local plants, offering services such as CNC and conventional machining, pump and gearbox repair, dynamic balancing, motor rewinding, and reverse engineering of obsolete parts. Naqa Iron aims to provide fast turnaround times for industrial clients in the region, reducing the need to send parts to distant cities. The Role of Business Unit Manager, Machining & Mechanical Services This full-time role is based in Yanbu, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, and requires over 10 years of experience. The Business Unit Manager will be responsible for developing and managing the Machining & Mechanical Services division. Yanbu is a significant industrial hub, and this position is critical for establishing Naqa Iron as a reliable local workshop for maintenance and shutdown needs for refineries, petrochemical plants, desalination and power plants, cement, steel, and port operations. Key Responsibilities Conduct weekly visits to plants in Yanbu Industrial City to build relationships with maintenance, reliability, and procurement teams. Scope jobs on site, including shafts, impellers, pump and gearbox overhauls, and spare parts made to drawing or sample, then price them and convert RFQs into purchase orders. Plan for plant shutdown and turnaround seasons, collaborating with turbine and shutdown contractors to ensure workshop bookings in advance. Work with the account manager to register and qualify Naqa Iron as a vendor with major operators and utilities in the region. Price each job based on workshop hours and materials estimates, confirming capacity before committing to a delivery date. Manage the division's profit and loss, including revenue, margin per job and client, and on-time delivery, addressing factors that impact margin such as underpricing, hour overruns, rework, and late payments. Develop new service offerings, including CNC production of repeat spares, reverse engineering of obsolete parts, and pump and gearbox overhaul packages. Expand the division's operations from Yanbu to Rabigh, Medina, King Abdullah Economic City (KAEC), and Umluj as growth occurs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to manage a workshop or business unit. Experience serving industrial plants in the Yanbu, Medina, Rabigh, King Abdullah Economic City, and Umluj regions. Proven track record of delivering results in a similar capacity. Benefits of Joining Opportunity to build and own the results of a growing division in Yanbu from an early stage. Ability to offer a competitive advantage with a full workshop located near Yanbu's industrial plants. Contribution to the localization of industrial services in the Kingdom, aligning with Vision 2030. A competitive compensation package based on experience. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply on LinkedIn with their CV and a brief note. The note should cover three key areas: the workshop or business managed, the plants served in the region, and the results delivered. Applications will be reviewed upon receipt.

e6d35d9ef4225aa4.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Refund Auditor to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves independently carrying out specific tasks under close supervision. The role focuses on contributing to operational tasks, communicating with customers for clarifications, and processing refund operations in accordance with established policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Review and study refund policies to ensure adherence to ZATCA’s rules, regulations, policies, and procedures, staying current on refund limit utilization and risk control authorizations. Develop and update assessment templates and audit tools to facilitate customer request analysis and timely evaluation. Monitor industry developments and new tax practices adopted by taxpayers to incorporate into assessments and audit reviews. Maintain and update refund manuals, eligibility criteria, legal requirements, and supporting documents, integrating them into computer-aided audit tools. Refund Operations Consolidate, categorize, and prioritize refund requests, sorting them by tax/industry type for dispatch to relevant audit teams. Review refund applications, examine the validity and completeness of legal and supporting documents. Gather data for desk audits, communicate with stakeholders (account managers, taxpayers, banks, government entities) for information and clarifications, and consult legal functions for contractual structures. Research public news and databases to understand taxpayers’ business activities, including structure, size, process, and jurisdictions. Assess taxpayers’ financial status, income statements, and revenue streams against benchmarks to determine assessment approaches. Inspect taxpayer declarations, identify high-risk issues, detect non-compliant cases, and communicate with internal stakeholders to mitigate potential risks. Consolidate legal and financial observations, evaluate against eligibility criteria, and recommend approval or rejection decisions. Manage the development of audit reports, including tax assessments, to determine taxpayers’ refund amounts. Develop lists of compliant taxpayers with accepted refunds and related amounts for internal committee approvals. Monitor taxpayer objections and appeals, coordinate with Legal Affairs or AMANA to resolve disputes, and provide clarifications on audit findings. e66550e2e65d3d98.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أرابسك للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات والمساعدة في الإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. هذه فرصة للمهندسين المعماريين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة للانضمام إلى بيئة عمل ديناميكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم المعمارية لمشاريع الإنشاءات الجديدة أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. إدارة فريق التصميم فيما يتعلق باختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية للمشاريع. إعداد النماذج بالحجم الطبيعي، الرسومات الهندسية، والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ المشاريع. تقديم الدعم الفني لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين لضمان الالتزام بالخطط. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. تقديم المشورة الفنية بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار مواقع المشاريع الجديدة والإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات الأولية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة والملحقات والتعديلات. مهارات في إعداد الرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة المبرز بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع لدعم مشاريع الإنشاءات والإشراف على التنفيذ. عن شركة أرابسك للاستشارات الهندسية تلتزم شركة أرابسك للاستشارات الهندسية بتقديم حلول هندسية ومعمارية متكاملة. نحن نسعى لتوظيف مهندسين معماريين يشاركوننا التزامنا بالجودة والابتكار في المشاريع الهندسية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

ملائمتها للمتطلبات النظامية والفنية. متابعة رفع طلبات اعتماد طرح المشاريع الخاصة بالقسم والتحليل الفني لعروض المتنافسين. المهام الإدارية والتشغيلية المشاركة في وضع الأهداف والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية مستوى الخدمات. المشاركة في تطوير سير العمل والإجراءات المتبعة في القسم، وضمان توثيق جميع السياسات والإجراءات والأنظمة والتقيد بها. مراقبة أداء القسم مقارنة بأهداف الأداء المقررة مسبقًا، لضمان سير العمل في الاتجاه المطلوب واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية والوقائية. إعداد الميزانية السنوية للقسم ومراقبتها وضمان الالتزام بها. تحديد احتياجات القسم من الكفاءات والمواهب، وتقديم التوصيات المتعلقة بقرارات الموارد البشرية. متابعة وتقييم أداء المرؤوسين وتحديد احتياجاتهم التدريبية والتوصية بالدورات اللازمة. عقد اجتماعات دورية مع المرؤوسين لمراجعة سير العمل ومناقشة الاقتراحات. إعداد تقارير دورية حول نشاطات وإنجازات القسم وتقديمها للمدير المباشر. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن الهيئة السعودية للمدن الصناعية ومناطق التقنية، وتتطلب الإشراف المباشر على مشاريع البنية التحتية والمباني في
